meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 它会往 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里装一个固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc 命令行工具,让 agent 直接在容器内把 Word、Excel、PPT、PDF 等本地附件转成 Markdown,不把文件上传给外部解析服务。纯图片 PDF 会明确报错。
howto.when: 当你的 agent 需要读取本地附加的 Word、Excel、PDF 等文档,又不希望把文件上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 这份纯图片 PDF 为什么转换失败?
say.note: 会确认它报错且未上传任何地方

howto.what_en: It installs a pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI into NanoClaw agent containers, so agents convert attached Word, Excel, PPT, PDF and similar local files to Markdown inside the container, without sending them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Use when agents need to read attached Word, Excel, PDF and similar local documents without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attachment in /workspace/inbox/ to Markdown and summarize it.
say_en.note: AnyDoc runs inside the container and returns Markdown.

say_en.text: Install add-anydoc so the agent can read Word and Excel attachments locally.
say_en.note: Pins the AnyDoc CLI and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Why did this image-only PDF fail to convert?
say_en.note: It confirms the failure and that nothing was uploaded.
